store.tagline: Template container app with the three surfaces: private by default, a static browser shell, and explicit public routes served in the clear.

store.description:
container-app-web is the template for a container app on the Privasys platform that serves a web page and a public API next to its private data.

THREE SURFACES
Everything an app serves is private unless its manifest says otherwise. This template declares a static surface (the browser shell, served in the clear so the page can load before a sealed session exists) and two public routes (a JSON status read and an inbound webhook). Everything else, including the signed-in user's identity and the stored events, is reachable only over a sealed session or RA-TLS.

MEASURED
The declaration rides the image's manifest label, so a verifier reads off the image exactly which routes this app serves in the clear, and changing them changes the digest the owner approves.

ANONYMOUS BY CONSTRUCTION
On a public route the runtime removes every credential and identity header before the app sees the request, so a mistake in app code cannot turn a public route into a channel for account data.

WHO IT IS FOR
Developers who need a web app, a public read or an inbound webhook on an app whose data must stay private.
